// diagnostic

E0737

A `{tag}` value decides {steers}.

What

A `{tag}` value decides {steers}.

Why

`{tag}` is `timing: .Fixed`: which code runs, how long it takes and which addresses it touches must not depend on it.

Fix

Compute both outcomes and choose with a masked select, or reveal the value through a `#Scrub({tag})` function first.

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0737: tests/ui/taint/fixed_timing_early_return_skipping_a_call_is_e0737.stderr.
